evidence_class: local integration checks using native operations and synthetic fixtures
scope: An isolated local backend on one host; no native client capture or incumbent project cutover is claimed.

upstream_tests.bounded_repair: Initialize the owned source archive as a git checkout, fetch the pinned source commit and reset the index without changing source/test files; git diff was empty.
upstream_tests.pending_scope: Six Trae workspace SQLite enable-switch cases; the default upstream test command excludes its E2E directory.

native_backend.install_method: Supported uv tool install commands in an isolated owned tool directory
native_backend.provider: Existing local OpenAI-compatible route to the user's selected Astra/max model
native_backend.lifecycle: Named native hindsight-embed profile with a separately named builtin pg0:// database
native_backend.initial_custom_directory_database: Supported Pg0 SDK started a separately owned database for the first qualification; it was emptied and stopped before final builtin-Pg0 recovery qualification.
native_backend.incumbent_service: Remained active/running with the same PID; final native health HTTP200. No original database, service unit or client hook/config was modified by this worker.

synthetic_fixture.author: This bounded qualification worker
synthetic_fixture.purpose: Exercise extraction, consolidation, provenance, corrected recall, reflection, derived pages, isolation, deletion, transfer and recovery without ingesting user history.

native_idempotent_start_follow_up.returned_status: Daemon Already Running; Daemon is already running
native_idempotent_start_follow_up.unhealthy_listener_recovery: Source-backed; long health probe then reclaim only a listener identified as Hindsight

initial_process_epoch_scope.source: Native Prometheus counters before first restart; distinct series grouped by scope

native_usage.counting_rule: Response usage is a subset of the epoch counters. Cache/thought counters are reported separately and are not added to input/output, to another snapshot or to billing. Later restart verification calls belong to separate process epochs.

incumbent_scope_observation.class: Read-only native capture-policy inspection; no event spooled/drained/sent
incumbent_scope_observation.both_installed_harnesses: Native hook commands use the same data directory, with no capture-mode or AI_MEMORY environment override.
incumbent_scope_observation.correction: A marker's ignore_paths does not disable lifecycle capture. Existing allowlist mode plus absent markers already excludes the owned production checkouts; no new global mode change is needed.

attempts_and_corrections.result: Package has no executable entry points; used the supported SDK already included with hindsight-api, then final builtin Pg0 integration.
